theme: Last day ashore before the charter.
greeting: Your last full day in Dubrovnik, Dan, and the calendar is clear. It is a day for the dry-land errands, because tomorrow the sailing charter takes over around 5 PM and connectivity thins to nothing for a week.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the sailing instructor
needsAttention.detail: You board tomorrow near 5 PM, but the exact meeting time and place, plus the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport, are still unconfirmed. Reach the Nautilus instructor today while you have a steady signal.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat hotel transfers and checkout
needsAttention.detail: Three things need arranging from shore before Saturday: the Komolac to Cavtat transfer on Sept 19, an early bag-hold at the Remisens, and the roughly 5:15 AM checkout on Sept 20 for the 7:30 flight. Charter connectivity is poor once you are underway.

needsAttention.title: Close out the Florida trip bookings
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20 to Oct 5 full-size SUV at Tampa is still unbooked, and the St Pete Airbnb for the landing gap was pending host confirmation. Both are worth finishing today before a week at sea makes them hard to touch.

flagged.title: A senior government-affairs role surfaced
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flagged an SVP-level global government affairs opening at Einride, close to your target profile. Worth a proper look once you are back online.

flagged.title: Your Dubrovnik host checked in
flagged.detail: Damjan messaged this morning asking whether everything is fine with the apartment. A one-line yes closes it out.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, travel deals, and promotions, plus a Todoist digest and a care.com applicant notice, none needing a reply.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn's first squash and chestnuts are coming into the markets now, worth building a meal around.

acts.line: Nothing is on the calendar before you board, so the whole morning is yours in the old town.
An open afternoon ashore, and the best of the day to sort anything that needs dry land and a real connection.
Your last evening in Dubrovnik before a week on the water; tomorrow the charter takes over around five.
